entries.title: Cat-morph
entries.subtitle: Feline Beastkin
entries.description: Cat-morphs possess prominent feline ears and a lithe tail, often accompanied by sharper reflexes and night-adjusted vision. They are known for their playful yet territorial demeanor.

entries.title: Half-demon
entries.subtitle: Demonic Hybrid
entries.description: Individuals infused with arcane demonic energy. They exhibit horns, pointed ears, and heightened affinity for arcane magic and emotional resonance.

entries.title: Human
entries.subtitle: Mundane Inhabitants
entries.description: The baseline species hailing from Earth, possessing no natural arcane aura without exposure to demonic essence or artifacts.

entries.title: Opaque Demonstone
entries.subtitle: Arcane Focus
entries.description: A dense crystal that hums with dormant arcane energy. When equipped, it channels environmental arcane pulses into defensive shields and spell potency.

entries.title: Smartphone
entries.subtitle: Earth Device
entries.description: A personal touchscreen device that has been adapted to recharge via the user's natural arcane aura, storing maps, contacts, and journal entries.

entries.title: Lilaya's Home F1
entries.subtitle: First Floor Residence
entries.description: The ground floor of Lilaya's expansive mansion, featuring carpeted corridors, guest quarters, research laboratories, and arcane lighting.

entries.title: Dominion
entries.subtitle: Demonic Metropolis
entries.description: The sprawling capital city constructed amidst ancient arcane ruins, bustling with various morph races, merchant bazaars, and guild halls.
